name: @examples/tsconfig-aliases
description: A tsconfig.json path alias ("@/*") used both by the app's own runtime import and resolved by env-cap's static analysis (ADR 0023), so the aliased contract is neither abandoned in the Dependency & Ownership Report nor left undocumented. Also installable as its own package -- see examples/tsconfig-aliases-consumer, which installs it from a real packed tarball and discovers its contract via the `packages` allowlist (ADR 0014), alongside its own, separately alias-organized, local contract.

scripts.pack:local: npm run build && npm pack --pack-destination . && mv examples-tsconfig-aliases-*.tgz tsconfig-aliases.tgz
